next.reason: 1985: "The storage area associated with identifier-1 and the record area associated with file-name-1 must not be the same storage area."; 2023: "14.6.10, Overlapping operands, and 14.9.25, MOVE statement, General rules, apply to any cases in which the storage area identified by identifier-1". 1985 refuses a program whose INTO item is the record area. 2023 has no such syntax rule; shared storage is handled by the overlapping-operand and MOVE rules, so the result may be undefined.
